results.honesty: Tiny Gateway · Rhyming Templates / Tiny Footprint: holographic rhyme = repeating · self-similar · self-correcting · recursive (four-pillar gate). Signature-bucket routing + recursive context-fold hooks + byte-touch joule PROXY are companion meters (K/L/M) — not semantic retrieval, not a KV-compression product, not wall-socket energy, not solar-synced clocks. In-process lab + (A) HtoD allocation proxy on GTX 860M and (B) REAL local-GPU LLM lab (sshleifer/tiny-gpt2 via torch-directml) measuring shared-prefix infer + AdamW train with vs without Tiny Footprint — those GPU meters are prefix-reuse, not rhyme proofs. Proxy ≠ model forward. DirectML on laptop GeForce ≠ datacenter HBM / hosted frontier API. Φ_EGS design grammar only. Engine pin is data-gated.
